binaries.name: yara
binaries.why: Match a recovered sample against rules the case supplies, recording the engine version, the ruleset's source, revision and hash, and each match's location. The only rules this pack ships are two note-text rules read by ransomware_family_match, none is fetched during an examination, and a ruleset for a sample is the case's; a match is a classification lead, not proof of execution or attribution. On Linux the image installs it from the Debian snapshot dated in images/debian-snapshot, so the version is the one Debian 12 (bookworm) held on that date (4.2.3-4 at the time of writing) and the image's inventory records it; the apt line is not edited, the snapshot pins it. Homebrew on macOS is not pinned.
